title: REPORT on the 2023 and 2024 Commission reports on Albania
part_text: 30. Expresses concern about continued political interference with and pressure on the judicial system; notes with concern shortcomings in the merit-based appointments of non-magistrate members of the High Judicial Council and the High Prosecution Council and their integrity; regrets the persistent challenges regarding the functioning of the judiciary noted in SPAK’s 2024 report;
